title: Review of Means-tested Thresholds for Annual Values of Properties Following Revision of Annual Values
what_it_is: Review of Means-tested Thresholds for Annual Values of Properties Following Revision of Annual Values

sections.label: Annual value review update
sections.summary: MOF said social support schemes including AV thresholds will be reviewed after the 2023 AV increase, with an update later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Given the 2023 increase in AVs, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) had previously informed that social support schemes, including the AV thresholds, will be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: An update will be provided later this year.

sections.label: New residences without AV
sections.summary: Applicants in new residences without a 2022 AV will not be shortchanged, and zero per capita household income HDB households keep the same subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But I note there may be applicants who are living in new residences which do not have an AV for 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But there are processes in place to ensure that they will not be shortchanged and all those HDB households with zero per capita household income will not be made worse off because of this discrepancy in the AV; they will continue to receive the same amount of subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The AV still remains a proxy of the means for the households and it is something that we still use to assess the support required.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For instance, those who are aged 65 and above receive higher subsidies of 75% at polyclinics, regardless of means; and for those who are in the Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation, these seniors also receive benefits, regardless of their per capita household income or the AV of their residence, such as subsidies for MediShield Life premiums, MediSave top-ups and higher subsidies at outpatient care.

sections.label: Back-end support and appeals
sections.summary: Back-end processes support these households, appeals will be looked at, and zero per capita household income cases get the same subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On the first point, there are back-end processes that make sure that they are supported.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But if there are appeals, they will definitely be looked at.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If it is zero per capita household income, we will definitely provide the same subsidies as per the others.
